title: NAS security parameters to E-UTRA information element

fields.name: NAS security parameters to E-UTRA IEI
NonceMME value
fields.description: This field is coded as the nonce value in the Nonce information element (see clause 9.9.3.25)

fields.name: Type of ciphering algorithm
fields.description: These fields are coded as the type of ciphering algorithm in the NAS security algorithms information element (see clause 9.9.3.23)

fields.name: spare
fields.description: Bit 4 of octet 6 is spare and shall be coded as zero

fields.name: Type of integrity protection algorithm
fields.description: These fields are coded as the type of integrity protection algorithm in the NAS security algorithms information element (see clause 9.9.3.23)

fields.name: spare
fields.description: Bit 8 of octet 6 is spare and shall be coded as zero

fields.name: spare
fields.description: Bit 5 to 8 of octet 7 are spare and shall be coded as zero

fields.name: TSC
fields.description: Type of security context flag - coded as in the NAS key set identifier information element (see clause 9.9.3.21)

fields.name: NAS key set identifier
fields.description: These fields are coded as the NAS key set identifier in the NAS key set identifier information element (see clause 9.9.3.21)

notes: The NAS security parameters to E-UTRA is a type 3 information element with a length of 7 octets
